nature.statement_zh: 本文件登记的是本方案自己做过的三类检查：按实际输出尺寸的字号与对比度校样、双语等价抽检、HTML 无障碍走查。三类检查均由方案方自行执行，以脚本量测与结构比对为主要手段，未经任何第三方机构认证，未经辅助技术使用者实测，也未经具备资质的译者逐词审校。凡本次未亲自复测而引自包内既有登记的读数，均在条目的 provenance 系列字段（provenance_zh / provenance_en）注明出处。
nature.statement_en: This file records three checks the proposer actually performed: type-size and contrast proofing at the real output size, bilingual-equivalence sampling, and an HTML accessibility walkthrough. All three were run by the proposer, primarily through scripted measurement and structural comparison. None was certified by a third party, tested with assistive-technology users, or reviewed word by word by a qualified translator. Any reading quoted from an existing package register rather than re-measured in this round is attributed in the entry's provenance fields (provenance_zh / provenance_en).

records.title_zh: 记录一 · 按实际输出尺寸的字号与对比度校样

records.purpose_en: To measure type size and contrast at the size and resolution at which reviewers actually receive the material, rather than judging legibility on a zoomed authoring view.

The previously registered 8.51 pt floor came from a register of 128 readings dated 2026-08-12; that register was not rebuilt this round and cannot be checked item by item, and the two rounds use different element sets and selection rules, so the readings are not interchangeable. This entry therefore does not claim to overturn the earlier value, only to record what the boards measure today. The 8.51 pt figure equals 3 mm, the size declared for the key-area inset labels (.kai-sb span); that inset no longer appears on the boards after the later revisions (zero elements whose class begins with kai on all 12 boards, leaving the rule as an unmatched declaration), so that size class is not present on the current boards

checks.limitations_en: A screen-rendered measurement; the actual legibility of the A0 boards also depends on mounting height and viewing distance, and no on-site viewing-distance verification was made this round. This item covers the page text layer only, not text inside the JPEG-embedded plates

The 7 geometry verification sheets added in v7.7 and the 2 reference plates added in v8.0 fall outside that measurement round and their type sizes are not covered by the 0% claim in this item; the district-strategy plate added in v8.2 and the two relational plates added in v8.3 and the three concept sheets added in v8.8 are measured separately at the same receiving-resolution caliber, reported at the end of this result
checks.result_zh: 二十六张带文字图版在接收分辨率口径下不可读文本占比全部为 0%（v6.8 新增双态平面图版双语两张，最小字号实测 12.00 px @1x、无溢出，装包前经生成器逐元素体检）——其中五张核心图最小字号 12.1—12.3 px（经三轮重排达成）；六张场景概念图的标注层文字按 CSS 字号 × 接收缩放比逐元素核算全部 ≥12 px（v5.17 将页眉、页脚与地标标签由 9—11 px 统一提升后达成），画面内 AI 生成的背景纹理不含文字；生态图谱、断面图版与企业旅程图版六张均为原生排版，最小字号 12 px。v5.21 增补画布边缘裁切扫描（双语逐图左右缘 12 像素列暗像素检测 + 目检）：发现并修复英文断面图左缘一处注记出画（首末注记改边锚重渲），复扫全部图版零出画。v8.2 新增的 `assets/figures/district-strategy.png` 单独实测：生成期对图版 DOM 逐元素读取 computedStyle 的 font-size，出现的字号为 12 / 13 / 16 / 23 CSS 像素，下限 12.0 像素（含全部 SVG 图面注记）；该图以 1200 × 750 CSS 像素按输出倍率 2.5 渲染为 3000 × 1875 像素，按接收分辨率短边压至 768 像素的重采样比 0.4096 折算，下限字号的等效值为 12.29 像素，不可读文本占比 0%；同轮以 Playwright 量测版心，body 滚动高度 750 对视口 750，零溢出。v8.3 新增的 `assets/figures/bluegreen-structure.png` 与 `assets/figures/heritage-sequence.png` 按与片区策略图版同一口径单独实测：生成期对两图 DOM 逐元素读取 computedStyle 的 font-size（含全部 SVG 图标注记与徽章），出现的字号分别为 12 / 13 / 15 / 16 / 22 CSS 像素，两图下限均为 12.0 像素；两图均以 1200 × 750 CSS 像素按输出倍率 2.5 渲染为 3000 × 1875 像素，按接收分辨率短边压至 768 像素的重采样比 0.4096 折算，下限字号的等效值为 12.29 像素，不可读文本占比 0%；同轮以 Playwright 量测版心，两图 body 滚动高度均为 750 对视口 750、滚动宽度 1200 对 1200，零溢出元素。该 12 像素下限是本轮的版面约束而非事后读数：接收分辨率下每行文字的高度不得低于图宽的百分之一，因此两图的每条中英短句都按所在栏宽压到单行，超出即改写。v8.8 新增的 `assets/figures/district-concept-sections.png`、`transport-system-concept.png` 与 `bluegreen-system-concept.png` 三张概念推演图按同一口径单独实测：对三图生成期页面源逐元素读取 font-size（含全部 SVG 图面注记与图例），出现的字号为 12 / 13 / 14 / 22 CSS 像素，三图下限均为 12.0 像素；三图均以 1200 × 750 CSS 像素按输出倍率 2.5 渲染为 3000 × 1875 像素，按接收分辨率短边压至 768 像素的重采样比 0.4096 折算，下限字号的等效值为 12.29 像素，不可读文本占比 0%。该 12 像素下限同为出图时的版面约束而非事后读数——三图共用生成件在其文档中把「CSS 字号下限取 12 px」写为出图前提，本轮对三份页面源逐元素复测确认无低于 12.0 像素的字号；三图为 pngquant 55-90 与 zopflipng 量化后的调色板位图，量化只改变颜色索引、不改变字形几何，故本项不对量化后位图另做像素级复测
checks.result_en: 0% illegible text on all twenty-six files at the receiving resolution: the five core figures reach a 12.1-12.3 px minimum after three re-typesets; the six concept-scene images hold every annotation-layer element at >=12 px (headers, footers and landmark labels raised from 9-11 px in v5.17), with no text in the AI-generated backdrop; the ecosystem, section and journey plates are natively typeset at a 12 px minimum. In v5.21 an edge-clipping scan was added (12-px edge-column dark-pixel detection plus visual check on every plate, both languages): one annotation running off the left edge of the English section plate was found and fixed (first and last annotations re-anchored to the edges and re-rendered), and a re-scan shows zero off-canvas text across all plates. The plate added in v8.2, assets/figures/district-strategy.png, is measured separately: a generation-time element-by-element read of computedStyle font-size on the plate DOM returns 12 / 13 / 16 / 23 CSS pixels, a floor of 12.0 px including every SVG map annotation; the plate is rendered from 1200 x 750 CSS pixels at an output factor of 2.5 into 3000 x 1875 pixels, and at the receiving resolution's resampling ratio of 0.4096 (768-pixel short edge) that floor becomes an effective 12.29 px, giving 0% illegible text. The same round measured the layout with Playwright: body scroll height 750 against a viewport of 750, zero overflow. The two plates added in v8.3, assets/figures/bluegreen-structure.png and assets/figures/heritage-sequence.png, are measured separately at the same caliber as the district-strategy plate: a generation-time element-by-element read of computedStyle font-size on both plate DOMs, including every SVG icon annotation and badge, returns 12 / 13 / 15 / 16 / 22 CSS pixels with a floor of 12.0 px on each; both are rendered from 1200 x 750 CSS pixels at an output factor of 2.5 into 3000 x 1875 pixels, and at the receiving resolution's resampling ratio of 0.4096 that floor becomes an effective 12.29 px, giving 0% illegible text. The same round measured the layout with Playwright: body scroll height 750 against a viewport of 750 and scroll width 1200 against 1200 on both, with zero overflowing elements. The 12-px floor was a layout constraint this round rather than an after-the-fact reading: at the receiving resolution no line of type may stand shorter than one hundredth of the image width, so every bilingual phrase on both plates was compressed to a single line at its column width and rewritten wherever it did not fit. The three concept sheets added in v8.8 — assets/figures/district-concept-sections.png, transport-system-concept.png and bluegreen-system-concept.png — are measured separately at the same caliber: an element-by-element read of font-size on the three generation-time page sources, including every SVG annotation and legend entry, returns 12 / 13 / 14 / 22 CSS pixels with a floor of 12.0 px on each; all three are rendered from 1200 x 750 CSS pixels at an output factor of 2.5 into 3000 x 1875 pixels, and at the resampling ratio of 0.4096 that floor becomes an effective 12.29 px, giving 0% illegible text. Here too the 12-px floor was a layout constraint at drawing time rather than an after-the-fact reading — the shared generator states a 12 px CSS floor as a precondition of the run — and this round re-read all three page sources element by element and found no type below 12.0 px. The three sheets are palette images quantised with pngquant 55-90 and zopflipng; quantisation changes colour indices only and not glyph geometry, so no pixel-level re-measurement was made on the quantised bitmaps

record_limitations_zh: 全部读数为屏幕渲染量测，与实物印刷存在渲染差异；本包未做实物打印样张检查。
A3 图带内注记的下限 4.48 pt 低于印刷常规下限，属已知取舍：该量级注记只承担形态证据，其判断内容已上移至页面文本层（下限 9.07 pt）。
字号与对比度达标不等于可读性达标；真实可读性还取决于字体、语言、观看距离、照明与读者视力，本次均未测。

四册 PDF 均未做语义标签（Tagged PDF：无标题层级、表格语义与阅读顺序结构树）。已实验两条生成路径：单页可产标签但逐页合并丢失结构树（跨文档结构树合并为现有开源工具链未解问题）；整册单次渲染因图版为绝对定位排版体系而多页叠印，保真不可接受。按诚实原则登记为局限而非硬贴无效标签；语义无障碍的随包等价载体为离线展示页（visual/index.html 双语）：全语义 HTML、键盘可达、替代文本齐备、无脚本降级，屏幕阅读器使用者可经该载体获得四册的判断内容。
record_limitations_en: All readings are screen-rendered measurements and differ from physical print; no physical press proof was made for this package.

The 4.48 pt floor of in-band annotations on A3 is below the usual print floor. This is a known trade-off: annotations at that size carry morphological evidence only, and their judgement content has been moved up into the page text layer (floor 9.07 pt).

Meeting size and contrast thresholds is not the same as being legible; real legibility also depends on typeface, language, viewing distance, lighting, and the reader's vision, none of which was tested.

None of the four PDF volumes is tagged (no heading hierarchy, table semantics or reading-order structure tree). Two generation paths were tested: single pages can be tagged but page-by-page merging drops the structure tree (cross-document structure-tree merging remains unsolved in the open-source toolchain), and whole-book single-pass rendering stacks pages because the plates use absolutely-positioned layout, with unacceptable fidelity. Per the honesty rule this is registered as a limitation rather than shipping ineffective tags; the in-package semantic equivalent is the offline display page (visual/index.html, bilingual): fully semantic HTML, keyboard reachable, complete alternative text, no-script fallback, through which screen-reader users can reach the volumes' judgement content.

record_limitations_zh: 本记录是结构级与抽样级核对，不是逐词翻译审校。
英文版由模型生成后经人工规则校验（结构、计数、锚点、术语一致性），未经具备资质的译者逐词审校，也未经英语母语专业读者通读。
结构等价不保证语义等价：两版可以结构完全对齐而个别措辞的含义强度不同，这一层本次未测。
record_limitations_en: This record covers structural and sampled checks, not a word-by-word translation review.

The English version was model-generated and then checked against rules by hand (structure, counts, anchors, terminology consistency). It was not reviewed word by word by a qualified translator, nor read through by a native-English professional reader.
Structural equivalence does not guarantee semantic equivalence: two versions can align structurally while individual wordings differ in the strength of their claim, a layer not tested here.

checks.tool_zh: playwright DOM 枚举 + CDP 可访问性树
checks.tool_en: playwright DOM enumeration + CDP accessibility tree
checks.scope_zh: 双语展示页全部图像元素
checks.scope_en: All image elements in both language versions
checks.result_zh: 每版 25 个 img，25 个全部具备非空 alt，无缺失、无空 alt；其中 2 个位于 <noscript> 内（禁用脚本时的静态后备图），启用脚本时的 DOM 枚举得 23 个。CDP 可访问性树复核：每版 24 个 image 角色节点（23 个 img 与 1 个内联 svg），全部具备可访问名称，被忽略的 image 节点为 0。中文版 alt 长度 25—272 字符，英文版 27—930 字符（中英字符密度不同，信息量相当）。抽样判读：五张图版的 alt 均描述图面内容与结论要点而非仅给标题，例如慢行图 alt 写明双态可达域与差集口径、四张判断卡要点、差集为待现场审计的靶区；v8.4 挂入的蓝绿三层结构（第 07 章）与百年遗产解说序列（第 12 章）两张关系图版，alt 除图面结构外逐条复述图上直印的免责判词。每版 1 个内联 svg（品牌标识），设 role="img" 并配 aria-label 描述图形构成。装饰性元素共 14 个：交互场景与三维主脊两处图例的 12 个色块与 AI 开关的 2 个刻度标记，全部设 aria-hidden="true"。v8.8 在第 06 章与第 07 章挂入三张概念推演图（district-concept-sections、transport-system-concept、bluegreen-system-concept），三张均为 figure 内的静态 img、不在 <noscript> 内，alt 逐张描述图面实线与虚线两类要素及图上直印的概念声明，figcaption 另载完整图版说明。本项读数的取得方式如实分列：img 总数与非空 alt 数由 22 增至 25 为本轮对双语页面源的直接解析实测（含 alt 非空与宽高属性齐备两项断言）；启用脚本时的 DOM 枚举由 20 增至 23、CDP 可访问性树 image 角色节点由 21 增至 24 两项为按新增静态节点数推算，本轮未重跑 Playwright 与 CDP。
checks.result_en: 25 img elements per version, all 25 with non-empty alt; none missing, none empty. Two of them sit inside <noscript> (the static fallback shown with scripts disabled), so a DOM enumeration with scripts enabled returns 23. Cross-checked against the CDP accessibility tree: 24 image-role nodes per version (23 img plus one inline svg), every one carrying an accessible name and zero image nodes ignored. Chinese alt text runs 25-272 characters and English 27-930, carrying comparable information at different character densities. Sample reading: the alt on all five drawings describes content and conclusions rather than only a title; the mobility drawing's alt states the dual-state reach domains, the gap definition, the four judgment cards, and the gap as a target for site audit; on the two relational plates mounted in v8.4 — blue-green structure in chapter 07 and the heritage sequence in chapter 12 — the alt restates, item by item, the disclaimers printed on the face of each plate in addition to describing its structure. Each version has one inline svg (the brand mark) with role="img" and an aria-label describing its construction. Fourteen decorative elements exist — the twelve legend swatches of the interactive scene and the 3-D spine plus the two AI-switch ticks — and all carry aria-hidden="true". v8.8 mounts three concept sheets in chapters 06 and 07 (district-concept-sections, transport-system-concept, bluegreen-system-concept); all three are static img elements inside a figure and none sits in <noscript>, each alt describing the solid and dashed element classes on the sheet and the concept declaration printed on its face, with the full plate note carried in the figcaption. How each reading was obtained is registered separately: the rise from 22 to 25 img elements, all with non-empty alt, was measured this round by parsing both page sources directly (asserting non-empty alt and present width and height on every image); the rise from 20 to 23 in the scripts-enabled DOM enumeration and from 21 to 24 in the CDP accessibility tree are derived from the number of new static nodes, as neither Playwright nor CDP was re-run this round.
checks.limitations_zh: alt 质量为抽样人工判读，未逐条评估是否完整传达图面全部信息；alt 无法替代复杂图版的完整数据，图内数据的等价获取路径依赖正文与结构化文件
checks.limitations_en: Alt quality was read by hand on a sample and was not assessed entry by entry for whether it conveys everything on the drawing; alt cannot replace the full data of a complex drawing, and the equivalent route to the in-drawing data depends on the proposal text and the structured files

checks.item_zh: 无脚本降级路径实测
checks.method_zh: 以禁用 JavaScript 的浏览器上下文实际加载页面，量测交互控件是否隐藏、noscript 降级文本与后备图是否呈现及其渲染尺寸，并截图留存
checks.method_en: Load the page in a browser context with JavaScript disabled, measure whether the interactive controls are hidden and whether the noscript text and fallback image render and at what size, and keep a screenshot
checks.tool_zh: playwright javaScriptEnabled:false 上下文 + 元素截图
checks.scope_zh: 双语展示页第 16 章交互场景及全页图版
checks.scope_en: Chapter 16 interactive scene and all page drawings, both language versions
checks.result_zh: 禁用脚本后，交互控件条、舞台与节点导轨三块按 noscript 内的样式规则全部隐藏；noscript 降级文本呈现（中文「此处为交互场景。当前浏览器未启用脚本，下图为静态后备视图。」，英文为对应表述）；静态后备图实际渲染，中文版 1384 × 525 像素，英文版 1384 × 517 像素，且带非空 alt。图例与口径说明两块保持可见，读者仍可获得线型、形状与边界含义。全页十二张章节图版与首屏后备图在无脚本条件下均正常呈现。
checks.result_en: With scripting disabled, the control bar, stage, and node rail are all hidden by the rules inside noscript; the noscript fallback text renders ("This is an interactive scene. Scripting is disabled in this browser, so the static fallback view is shown below.", with the matching Chinese wording); the static fallback image actually renders at 1384 x 525 px (zh) and 1384 x 517 px (en) with non-empty alt. The legend and the caveat note stay visible, so line types, shapes, and boundary meanings remain available. All twelve chapter drawings and the first-screen fallback image render normally without scripting.
checks.evidence_zh: 本次走查对无脚本状态下的交互场景区做了元素截图留存，用于人工复看
checks.evidence_en: This walkthrough kept an element screenshot of the interactive-scene area in the no-script state, for later human review
checks.limitations_zh: 禁用脚本的降级已验证；未验证脚本加载失败但未被禁用（如资源加载中断）时的中间态表现
checks.limitations_en: The fallback with scripting disabled is verified; the intermediate state in which scripting is not disabled but fails to load (an interrupted resource request, for example) was not

checks.item_zh: 字幕、音轨与文字稿在 HTML 中的挂载
checks.item_en: Caption, audio, and transcript attachment in the HTML
checks.method_zh: 枚举页面内 video、audio 与 track 元素，并检索指向字幕、媒体与文字稿文件的链接
checks.method_en: Enumerate video, audio, and track elements in the page and search for links pointing to caption, media, or transcript files
checks.tool_zh: playwright DOM 枚举
checks.scope_en: Both language versions, whole page
checks.result_zh: 实测结果为零：双语展示页均不含 video 或 audio 元素，track 元素数为 0，页面内也没有指向 .vtt、.mp4、.m4a 或文字稿的链接。因此本页不存在字幕轨挂载问题，也没有可在页面内核查的字幕开关。短片、语音导览、四个字幕文件与三份文字稿作为独立资产随包提交于 assets/media，其双语等价性由记录二第 07、08 条覆盖。
checks.result_en: The measured result is zero: neither language version contains a video or audio element, the track count is 0, and the page carries no link to .vtt, .mp4, .m4a, or a transcript. There is therefore no caption track to attach on this page and no in-page caption control to check. The film, the audio guide, the four caption files, and the three transcripts are submitted as separate assets under assets/media, and their bilingual equivalence is covered by entries 07 and 08 of Record 2.
checks.limitations_zh: 如实登记的结果是「页面内无时基媒体」。时基媒体的可及性因此不由本页承担，而依赖使用者自行以外部播放器载入随包字幕；页面未提供播放入口这一点属于设计现状，不属于本次修复范围
checks.limitations_en: The result registered as found is that the page contains no time-based media. Accessibility of time-based media therefore does not rest with this page but depends on the user loading the packaged captions in an external player. That the page offers no playback entry point is the current design state and is outside the scope of this round's fixes.

checks.item_zh: 颜色非唯一编码逐项核查
checks.item_en: Item-by-item check that colour is never the only encoding
checks.method_zh: 对每一处以颜色区分信息的位置，读取其形状线索（边框样式、圆角、裁剪路径、渐变）与文字线索，逐项判断是否存在第二编码
checks.method_en: For every place where colour distinguishes information, read its shape cues (border style, radius, clip path, gradient) and text cues, and judge item by item whether a second encoding exists
checks.tool_zh: playwright getComputedStyle 逐元素读取
checks.scope_zh: 交互场景图例六项、品牌色板六项、十节点卡片、读数面板、七类测试与三类自检状态卡
checks.scope_en: The six legend entries in the interactive scene, the six brand swatches, the ten node cards, the readout panel, the seven test cards, and the three self-check status cards

findings.encoding_zh: 实线色条 + 文字标签「主脊 · 通用可达底线」+ 说明「两条等价路径之一」
findings.encoding_en: A solid colour bar + the text label "Spine · universal-access baseline" + the note "One of two equivalent routes"

findings.encoding_zh: 重复线性渐变呈虚线形态（非实色）+ 文字标签 + 说明明写「虚线，第二条等价路径」
findings.encoding_en: A repeating linear gradient rendered as a dashed form (not a solid colour) + a text label + a note that states "Dashed; the second equivalent route"

findings.encoding_zh: 圆形（border-radius 50%）+ 文字标签含编号区间 OP-01—OP-10
findings.encoding_en: A circle (border-radius 50%) + a text label carrying the id range OP-01 to OP-10

findings.encoding_zh: 菱形（clip-path 四点多边形）+ 文字标签 + 说明明写「珊瑚色只用于人工接管与求助」
findings.encoding_en: A diamond (a four-point clip-path polygon) + a text label + a note that states "coral is reserved for handover and help"

findings.encoding_zh: 三角形（clip-path 三点多边形）+ 文字标签 + 三处地标名称
findings.encoding_en: A triangle (a three-point clip-path polygon) + a text label + the names of the three landmarks

findings.item_zh: 图例·临时重点区与总体范围
findings.item_en: Legend: provisional key areas and overall scope
findings.encoding_zh: 虚线边框（border-style dashed）+ 文字标签 + 说明明写「虚线边表示非法定边界」
findings.encoding_en: A dashed border (border-style dashed) + a text label + a note that states "Dashed edges mean non-statutory boundaries"

findings.encoding_zh: 每张卡片文本内含十六进制色值与色名（如「深青 #10383d」），并附用途说明；色块本身为纯装饰
findings.encoding_en: Each card carries the hex value and the colour name in its text ("DEEP TEAL #10383d", for example) together with a note on its use; the swatch itself is purely decorative

findings.encoding_zh: 卡片顶边颜色按位置轮换，仅作版面节奏，不承载信息；每张卡片以文字给出节点编号、场景编号、闸门编号与名称
findings.encoding_en: The top-border colour rotates by position for layout rhythm only and carries no information; each card gives the node id, the scenario id, the gate id, and the name in text

findings.encoding_zh: 术语与数值均为文字（含「未测（unknown）」「待现场审计」），不以颜色区分声明值与实测值，两者以文字术语分列
findings.encoding_en: Terms and values are all text (including "unknown (unmeasured)" and "pending site audit"); declared and measured values are not distinguished by colour but are listed separately by wording

findings.encoding_zh: 每张卡片以文字标注「待真实测试」，不以颜色表示状态
findings.encoding_en: Each card is marked "PENDING REAL TEST" in text; status is not conveyed by colour

findings.encoding_zh: 以文字给出状态（PASS AFTER FINALIZE、PASS · PROVISIONAL WARNINGS、PASS AFTER FINAL QA），不以颜色表示通过与否
findings.encoding_en: Status is given in text (PASS AFTER FINALIZE, PASS · PROVISIONAL WARNINGS, PASS AFTER FINAL QA); pass or fail is not conveyed by colour

findings.item_en: The rule the page states about itself
findings.encoding_zh: 第 12 章明写「颜色不得单独承载信息：任何以颜色区分的状态必须同时具备形状、文字或触觉冗余」，英文版有对应表述
findings.encoding_en: Chapter 12 states "Colour never carries information alone: any colour-coded state must also carry shape, text or tactile redundancy", with the matching Chinese wording in the zh version

checks.result_zh: 逐项核查 12 项，未发现以颜色为唯一编码的信息。所有颜色区分处均同时具备形状、线型或文字标签中的至少一种第二编码，与页面自述规则一致。
checks.result_en: Twelve items checked one by one, with no information found to be encoded by colour alone. Every colour-coded distinction also carries at least one of shape, line type, or a text label, consistent with the rule the page states about itself.
checks.limitations_zh: 以计算样式与文本内容判断，未做色觉障碍模拟渲染，也未请色觉障碍使用者判读
checks.limitations_en: Judged from computed styles and text content, without simulated colour-vision-deficiency rendering and without asking users with a colour vision deficiency to read it

checks.item_zh: 页面结构与地标
checks.method_zh: 统计标题层级、地标元素、状态播报区与控件可访问名，并用 CDP 读取完整可访问性树核对地标名称
checks.method_en: Count heading levels, landmark elements, live regions, and control accessible names, and read the full accessibility tree via CDP to verify landmark names
checks.tool_zh: playwright DOM 统计 + CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree
checks.scope_en: Both language versions, whole page
checks.result_zh: 双语计数全等：h1 各 1 个、h2 各 18 个、h3 各 6 个，层级无跳级；地标 nav 1、main 1、footer 1，首屏概览段落设 aria-label；状态播报区 2 个，role="status" 且 aria-live="polite"，以视觉隐藏但屏幕阅读器可读的方式实现；按钮 34 个，其中 32 个带 aria-pressed 状态；AI 开关外层设 role="group" 并有可访问名；画布设 role="img" 并随 AI 开关改写 aria-label。跳转链接目标存在。全部 20 个图像（noscript 外）均带 alt，aria-label 各 5 处，双语数量一致。
checks.result_en: Counts are identical in both languages: 1 h1, 18 h2, 6 h3, with no skipped levels; landmarks are 1 nav, 1 main, 1 footer, with the first-screen overview section carrying an aria-label; two live regions with role="status" and aria-live="polite", implemented as visually hidden but screen-reader readable; 15 buttons, 14 of them carrying aria-pressed; the AI switch wrapper has role="group" with an accessible name; the canvas has role="img" with an aria-label rewritten as the AI switch changes. The skip-link target exists. All 20 images (outside noscript) carry alt, and there are 5 aria-labels per version, equal across languages.
checks.limitations_zh: 结构与名称的机器核对，未验证屏幕阅读器实际朗读时的地标跳转体验
checks.limitations_en: A machine check of structure and names; the landmark-navigation experience when a screen reader actually reads the page was not verified

record_limitations_zh: 本走查为机器辅助走查：以无头浏览器注入键盘事件、读取计算样式与可访问性树的方式进行，未经屏幕阅读器与辅助技术使用者实测。
未使用 NVDA、JAWS、VoiceOver、TalkBack 等屏幕阅读器验证实际朗读顺序与措辞，也未做放大镜、语音控制、开关控制或单手操作的验证。
只在 Chromium 引擎与 1440 × 900 视口下量测，未在其他浏览器引擎、移动端触屏或高对比度模式下复测。
本记录是方案方自查，不是无障碍合规认证，不构成对任何标准符合性等级的声明。
record_limitations_en: This is a machine-assisted walkthrough: keyboard events were injected through a headless browser and computed styles and the accessibility tree were read. It was not tested with screen readers or by assistive-technology users.
No screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) was used to verify actual reading order or phrasing, and no magnifier, voice control, switch control, or one-handed operation was tested.
Measurements were taken only on the Chromium engine at a 1440 x 900 viewport, without retesting on other browser engines, mobile touch screens, or high-contrast mode.
This record is the proposer's self-check, not an accessibility conformance certification, and asserts no level of conformance with any standard.

records.title_zh: 多感官交付自查（v6.0—v6.1：触觉三件、数据可听化）
records.title_en: Multisensory deliverables self-check (v6.0–v6.1: three tactile items, sonification)

records.purpose_en: The hand and ear channels of the deliverables checked to the same standard as everything else: structure, mapping, timeline and integrity measured and registered item by item

checks.item_zh: 触觉地图三维模型网格完整性
checks.method_zh: 解析 STL 二进制逐三角枚举边并统计共享数；重建哈希自校验
checks.method_en: Parse the binary STL, enumerate edges per triangle and count sharing; self-verify the rebuild hash
checks.tool_zh: Python struct/hashlib（标准库）
checks.scope_zh: visual/assets/op04-tactile-map.json 内封装的全部网格
checks.scope_en: the full mesh wrapped in op04-tactile-map.json

A first draft's six coplanar shared edges were eliminated by the embedded construction, recorded in the file's mesh_integrity field

checks.limitations_en: slicer compatibility inferred from mainstream behaviour, not tested per application; tactile distinctness untested with blind or low-vision users

checks.limitations_en: not proofread by a braille user or certified transcriber (stated in the file); the Chinese edition remains pending professional collaboration

checks.method_en: Check SVG dimensions and elements: A4 canvas, unfolded segment count, fold-line types, dot count

checks.tool_en: text parsing (the SVG is hand-written markup)

findings.status_en: Found in the walkthrough and fixed
findings.problem_zh: 中文页面（lang="zh-CN"）的章节导航地标可访问名为英文小写 chapters，与页面语言不符，也与同页其余四处中文 aria-label 的体例不一致。经 CDP 可访问性树核对，该地标在树中的名称确为 chapters。
findings.problem_en: On the Chinese page (lang="zh-CN") the chapter-navigation landmark had the accessible name "chapters" in lowercase English, which does not match the page language and is inconsistent with the four other Chinese aria-labels on the same page. The CDP accessibility tree confirmed the landmark name as "chapters".
findings.fix_zh: 中文版改为「章节导航」，英文版同步改为 Chapters（与同页其余可访问名的首字母大写体例一致）。
findings.fix_en: Changed to 章节导航 in the Chinese version and to Chapters in the English version, matching the capitalisation of the other accessible names on the page.
findings.verification_zh: 修复后重跑 CDP 可访问性树，中文版地标名为「章节导航」，英文版为 Chapters；双语计数断言全等：aria-label 各 5、nav 各 1、导航链接各 15、按钮各 15、图像各 9 且 9 个均有 alt、可聚焦元素各 33（含展开态的场景卡关闭按钮），页面脚本错误 0。
findings.verification_en: After the fix the CDP accessibility tree was read again: the landmark name is 章节导航 in the Chinese version and Chapters in the English one. The bilingual count assertions are all equal: 5 aria-labels each, 1 nav each, 15 navigation links each, 15 buttons each, and 9 images each with all 9 carrying alt, plus 33 focusable elements each (including the scenario-card close button in the open state), with 0 page script errors.

findings.status_zh: 走查发现并登记；2026-08-15 复测确认已修复——第 755 行现引用语言字典的 period 字段（中文全角、英文半角），英文播报以半角句号结尾
findings.status_en: Found in the walkthrough and registered; re-tested 2026-08-15 and confirmed fixed — line 755 now reads the period field of the language dictionary (ideographic in zh, ASCII in en), so the English announcement ends with an ASCII full stop
findings.problem_zh: 节点选中时的状态播报文本由「前缀 + 节点编号 + 节点名称 + 句号」拼接而成，句号在代码中硬编码为中文全角句号，中英两版共用同一行拼接代码。实测英文版播报为「Selected OP-04 Continuous-passage break joint-test point。」，英文语句末尾出现中文全角句号。
findings.problem_en: The status announcement for a selected node is assembled as prefix + node id + node name + full stop, and the full stop is hard-coded as a Chinese ideographic period in a line shared by both languages. The English announcement was measured as "Selected OP-04 Continuous-passage break joint-test point。", ending an English sentence with a Chinese period.
findings.impact_zh: 屏幕阅读器在英文语音引擎下遇到全角句号，可能不作断句处理或读出异常字符；同时这是英文版文本中混入中文标点，与包内双语等价纪律不一致。
findings.impact_en: Under an English speech engine a screen reader that meets an ideographic period may not treat it as a sentence break, or may read out an unexpected character; it is also Chinese punctuation mixed into English text, which is inconsistent with the bilingual-equivalence discipline of the package.

findings.status_zh: 双语抽检发现并登记；2026-08-15 复测确认该空行已在位（现行第 691—693 行两段以空行分隔，双语逐行对齐），渲染产物中两段各自独立成段
findings.status_en: Found in bilingual sampling and registered; re-tested 2026-08-15 and confirmed the blank line is now in place (lines 691–693 separate the two paragraphs, aligned line by line across languages), and the rendered output shows two distinct paragraphs
findings.location_zh: proposal.md 第 622 行与第 623 行之间
findings.problem_zh: 中文版正文在「上表三类人群不新增用户画像……」段与「**伦理与同意协议包（模板 · 未执行）。**」段之间缺一个空行，两段在 Markdown 语义下被视为同一段落；英文版对应位置有空行，分为两段。逐行结构类型比对因此从该处起出现一行偏移，折叠空行后结构类型序列仍为零不一致，说明差异仅在段落分隔而非结构本身。
findings.problem_en: In the Chinese text there is no blank line between the paragraph beginning "上表三类人群不新增用户画像" and the paragraph beginning "**伦理与同意协议包（模板 · 未执行）。**", so Markdown treats them as one paragraph, while the English version has the blank line and renders two. The line-by-line comparison therefore shifts by one line from that point; with blank lines collapsed the type sequence still shows zero mismatches, confirming the difference lies in paragraph separation rather than structure.
findings.impact_zh: 登记时曾传导到渲染产物（中文版两段合并于同一 p 元素）；复测时该影响已随空行修复消失，现行渲染产物两段各自独立。
findings.impact_en: At registration time the issue had carried through to the rendered output (the two zh paragraphs merged into one p element); on re-test the impact is gone with the blank line restored, and the current rendered output shows two separate paragraphs.

findings.status_zh: 走查观察，实测通过，登记为跨浏览器稳健性局限
findings.status_en: Observation; passed under test, registered as a cross-browser robustness limitation
findings.problem_zh: 正文容器未设 tabindex="-1"，跳转链接激活后焦点并未落到容器本身，而依赖 Chromium 的顺序焦点导航起点机制把后续 Tab 起点移入正文。
findings.problem_en: The main container carries no tabindex="-1", so after the skip link is activated focus does not land on the container itself; it relies instead on Chromium's sequential focus navigation starting point to move the next Tab into main.
findings.measurement_zh: 在 Chromium 上实测：激活跳转链接后地址片段变为 #main、页面滚到正文顶部，随后一次 Tab 落在正文内第一个链接，跳过十五个导航链接，功能上生效。
findings.measurement_en: Measured on Chromium: activating the skip link sets the fragment to #main and scrolls the page to the top of main, and the next Tab lands on the first link inside main, skipping the fifteen navigation links, so it works in practice.
findings.not_fixed_reason_zh: 本轮实测该路径在目标环境下有效，且加设 tabindex="-1" 会使正文容器在键盘激活时匹配 :focus-visible，产生一圈环绕整页正文的焦点描边（已用副本实测确认），需另配样式抑制，改动面超出「仅走查修复」的范围。如实登记为已知局限，建议后续连同焦点样式一并处理。
findings.not_fixed_reason_en: This round measured the path as effective in the target environment, and adding tabindex="-1" would make the main container match :focus-visible on keyboard activation, producing a focus outline around the whole body of the page (confirmed by measurement on a copy). Suppressing it would require an additional style rule, putting the change beyond the scope of walkthrough fixes alone. It is registered as a known limitation, to be handled later together with the focus style.

findings.location_zh: visual/index.html · visual/index.en.html · 第 12 章品牌色板的六个色块元素
findings.location_en: visual/index.html · visual/index.en.html · the six brand-palette swatch elements in chapter 12
findings.problem_zh: 品牌色板的六个装饰色块未设 aria-hidden="true"，而交互场景图例的六个色块设了，同页同类装饰元素的处理体例不一致。
findings.problem_en: The six decorative swatches of the brand palette carry no aria-hidden="true" while the six swatches in the interactive-scene legend do, so decorative elements of the same kind are handled inconsistently on the same page.
findings.measurement_zh: 用 CDP 读取完整可访问性树核对：品牌色板的六个色块在树中的节点数为 0，交互场景图例已设 aria-hidden 的六个色块同样为 0。两组表现完全相同，说明这六个空元素本就不进入可访问性树、不产生任何播报。
findings.measurement_en: Verified by reading the full accessibility tree via CDP: the six brand swatches produce 0 nodes in the tree, and the six legend swatches that do carry aria-hidden produce 0 as well. The two groups behave identically, showing that these six empty elements never enter the accessibility tree and produce no announcement.
findings.not_fixed_reason_zh: 实测证明加设 aria-hidden 对播报结果无任何差别，属于体例统一而非缺陷修复。按最小改动原则不作修改，如实登记为观察项。
findings.not_fixed_reason_en: Measurement shows that adding aria-hidden makes no difference to what is announced, so it would be a consistency change rather than a defect fix. Under the minimal-change principle nothing was changed, and it is registered as an observation.

findings.problem_zh: 双语展示页均不含 video 与 audio 元素，track 元素数为 0，页面内也无指向字幕、媒体或文字稿的链接。短片、语音导览、四个字幕文件与三份文字稿以独立资产随包提交。
findings.problem_en: Neither language version of the display page contains a video or audio element, the track count is 0, and the page carries no link to captions, media, or a transcript. The film, the audio guide, the four caption files, and the three transcripts are submitted as separate assets in the package.
findings.note_zh: 本项不是缺陷判定，而是走查范围内的事实登记：页面不承担时基媒体的播放，因此不存在可在页面内核查的字幕挂载与字幕开关。
findings.note_en: This is not a defect verdict but a fact registered within the scope of the walkthrough: the page does not carry playback of time-based media, so there is no caption attachment and no caption control to check within the page.

findings.status_zh: 走查观察，无害冗余，未修改
findings.problem_zh: 焦点样式规则同时覆盖交互场景内的按钮与画布，但画布未设 tabindex，实测不可聚焦，该规则中的画布选择器不会生效。
findings.problem_en: The focus style rule covers both the buttons and the canvas inside the interactive scene, but the canvas carries no tabindex and was measured as not focusable, so the canvas selector in that rule never takes effect.
findings.note_zh: 键盘路径由十个节点按钮承担，页面亦以文字写明「用鼠标点击场景中的节点，或用 Tab 走到下方节点按钮后按 Enter」，键盘等价路径完整，故该冗余不构成缺陷。
findings.note_en: The keyboard path is carried by the ten node buttons, and the page states in text "Click a node in the scene, or Tab to a node button below and press Enter", so the keyboard-equivalent path is complete and the redundancy is not a defect.

known_limitations_zh: 本文件是方案方自查记录，不是第三方认证、不是无障碍合规声明、不是辅助技术使用者的实测报告。
三类检查均以脚本量测与结构比对为主要手段。凡是需要真实读者、真实译者、真实辅助技术使用者或实物印品才能得出的结论，本文件一律不作声明。
记录一的 A3、A0 字号读数与五图可读性读数引自包内既有登记，本轮未重跑；重跑的部分（PDF 页数与体量、对比度复算、图版成对性）已在条目的 provenance 系列字段分别注明。
记录二是结构级与抽样级核对，英文版由模型生成后经人工规则校验，未经具备资质的译者逐词审校。
记录三只在 Chromium 引擎、1440 × 900 视口、file:// 离线加载条件下执行，未在其他浏览器引擎、移动端触屏、高对比度模式或屏幕阅读器下复测。
本文件不改变任何指标。metrics.json 中七项包容性指标的状态维持为待实测，不因本文件的存在而变化。
本文件登记的检查通过与否，不构成对现场服务可用性的任何声明；现场绩效的状态由包内既有条款维持为未获授权、未现场运行。
known_limitations_en: This file is the proposer's own self-check record. It is not a third-party certification, not an accessibility conformance claim, and not a test report from assistive-technology users.

All three checks rely primarily on scripted measurement and structural comparison. This file asserts no conclusion that would require real readers, real translators, real assistive-technology users, or a physical printed piece.

In Record 1 the A3 and A0 type-size readings and the legibility readings for the five drawings are quoted from an existing package register and were not re-run this round; the parts that were re-run (PDF page count and file size, the contrast recomputation, drawing pairing) are attributed individually in the provenance fields of each entry.
Record 2 covers structural and sampled checks; the English version was model-generated and then checked against rules by hand, and was not reviewed word by word by a qualified translator.

Record 3 was executed only on the Chromium engine, at a 1440 x 900 viewport, loaded offline over file://, without retesting on other browser engines, mobile touch screens, high-contrast mode, or screen readers.
This file changes no metric. The seven inclusion metrics in metrics.json remain unmeasured, and the existence of this file does not change that.

Whether the checks registered in this file pass or fail constitutes no claim about the availability of the service on the ground; the status of field performance is held by the package's existing statements as "not authorized · not field-run".
